overall_assessment: The toolchain integrity, lockfile reproducibility, and static governance architecture codified across rust-toolchain.toml, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, conductor/tech-stack.md, docs/msrv-and-package-policy.md, scripts/check_toolchain_manifest.py, scripts/check_rust_dependency_graph.py, scripts/bootstrap.sh, scripts/bootstrap.ps1, scripts/verify.sh, scripts/run_static_harness.py, scripts/validate_repository.py, and tests/test_foundation_toolchain_governance.py establish exceptional operational discipline. In rust-toolchain.toml, the Rust channel is strictly pinned to 1.97.1 stable with MSRV and experimental policies fully articulated in docs/msrv-and-package-policy.md. Cargo.lock is committed and pinned to exact dependency hashes using workspace resolver 3 and Rust edition 2024. The toolchain manifest check (scripts/check_toolchain_manifest.py) verifies 11 pinned cargo tools across developer environments deterministically. The static harness (scripts/run_static_harness.py) enforces 57 fail-closed gates validating manifests, context integrity, dependency graphs, and code hygiene network-free. One-command bootstrap (scripts/bootstrap.sh, bootstrap.ps1) and verification (scripts/verify.sh) entrypoints ensure reproducible execution across developer and CI workstations. The supply-chain audit boundary is accurately preserved: a frozen cargo-vet check confirms 43 vetted dependencies and 259 existing exemptions without improperly claiming unverified dependencies are audited. All 6 tests in tests/test_foundation_toolchain_governance.py pass network-free.
verified_invariants: Rust toolchain pin: rust-toolchain.toml strictly locks channel 1.97.1 stable with documented MSRV and nightly policy
Committed workspace lockfile: Cargo.lock is committed with workspace resolver 3 and edition 2024 dependencies
Toolchain manifest conformance: scripts/check_toolchain_manifest.py verifies 11 pinned cargo tools across development environments
Deterministic dependency graph check: scripts/check_rust_dependency_graph.py verifies crate dependencies without network access
One-command bootstrap entrypoints: scripts/bootstrap.sh and scripts/bootstrap.ps1 provision local developer environments deterministically
Static harness governance: scripts/run_static_harness.py enforces 57 static verification gates across the entire workspace
Deterministic test verification: tests/test_foundation_toolchain_governance.py verifies toolchain pins, lockfile, and bootstrap scripts network-free

findings.description: Frozen cargo-vet policy check verifies 43 fully vetted dependencies with 259 existing exemptions; exempted dependencies are not claimed audited, preserving accurate claim boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Continue phased cargo-vet audits across dependency refresh cycles without claiming exemption parity with audit.

findings.description: One-command bootstrap and verification entrypoints (bootstrap.sh, verify.sh, run_static_harness.py) run fail-closed, ensuring immediate rejection of corrupted toolchains or uncommitted modifications.
findings.recommendation: Preserve network-free static harness execution prior to any networked compiler invocations.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Rust 1.97.1 stable pinned in rust-toolchain.toml, MSRV and experimental policies documented in docs/msrv-and-package-policy.md, and toolchain manifest verified across 11 pinned tools.
Cargo.lock committed and validated, Cargo.toml configured with edition 2024 and resolver 3, and dependency graph checked via check_rust_dependency_graph.py.
One-command bootstrap and verification entrypoints created and verified, 57 static gates in run_static_harness.py passing, and validate_repository.py passing.

limitations: Rust 1.97.1 toolchain pin, committed lockfile, and static verification gates verified; full clean-room compiler matrix execution on live release infrastructure remains an open operational gate.
